findings.message: 4 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Uzmanlık Alanlarımız" (pill) above "Projelerimiz & Uzmanlık Alanlarımız"; "Hakkımızda" (pill) above "Nova Agro — Geleceğin Tarımını İleri Müh"; "Hizmetlerimiz" (pill) above "5 Temel Ziraat Mühendisliği & AgTech Hiz"; "Bilgi Merkezi" (pill) above "AgTech Bilgi Merkezi & Makaleler"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: Material Symbols Outlined, monospace — e.g. "arrow_forward", "arrow_forward", "arrow_forward", "chevron_left"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: 4 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Uzmanlık Alanlarımız", "Hakkımızda", "Hizmetlerimiz", "Bilgi Merkezi").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: Emoji in the page: 🧪
findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.
Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 41 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: span → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25) 0px 4px 14px 0px | span → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25) 0px 4px 14px 0px | span → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25) 0px 4px 14px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 10 text-shadow(s).
findings.fix: Remove; fix legibility with a scrim or a different crop.

findings.message: Buttons with shadow/glow.
findings.fix: Flat fill, one colour.

findings.message: 12 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.header 1440px | section#about.about-section 1440px | div 291px | div 291px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 14 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 1 dashed/dotted border(s).
findings.fix: Remove unless it is a real drop zone.

findings.message: 3 backdrop-blur surfaces.
findings.fix: One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: 1 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (5 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "Ana Sayfa" 3.3:1 needs 4.5:1; "Detaylı Bilgi" 3.3:1 needs 4.5:1; "arrow_forward" 3.3:1 needs 4.5:1; "Detaylı Bilgi" 3.3:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.

findings.message: 3 typefaces in use (Work Sans, Material Symbols Outlined, Arial).
findings.fix: Two at most.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 13.6px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: Only 3 picture(s) on the page (3 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 100 characters per line.
findings.fix: Cap paragraphs at 45–75 characters (max-width: 60ch).

findings.message: 13 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The margins differ: 152px on the left, 171px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: The h1 is 24px ("Nova Agro").
findings.fix: Set the title at display size, or make the large text of the first screen the h1.

findings.message: The h1 is a bare name ("Nova Agro") and nothing else on the first screen says what this is.
findings.fix: Keep the name if it leads, and give the line under it (18px or more) the plain words: what it is, for whom, where or when. In the study of 97 Sites of the Day, first screens that named nothing lost usability and content points.

findings.message: Only 4 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Build the motion layer (SKILL.md step 9, references/motion.md): the signature move, an entrance for the parts of every section, feedback on every control, and one moving picture. Transform and opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.message: 7 text block(s) sit within 16px of the screen edge: "Hassas Tarım & Akıllı Sulama O" (0px from the left); "IoT Toprak Nem Sensörleri ve Y" (0px from the left); "Toprak nemi ve mikroklima veri" (0px from the left); "arrow_forward" (0px from the left)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–32px or more). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.

findings.message: 8 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "Nova Agro — Zirai Drone & Multispektral Analiz" → 3 lines (8 words, 32px); "Modern Sera Otomasyonu & İklimlendirme" → 3 lines (5 words, 32px); "IoT Toprak Nem Sensörleri ve Yapay Zeka Destekli" → 3 lines (10 words, 24px); "RTK Destekli Hassas Otonom İlaçlama ve NDVI Bitk" → 3 lines (10 words, 24px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.

findings.message: 4 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.
